integrity: Original inequalities follow from an analytic Lambert-envelope and exact positive-support optimization. Finite-cell code is a supplementary test, not an exhaustive proof. No external mathematical validation is represented.
scientific_limitations: The unrestricted range quasi-gauge has only a two-sided bound for indicator mass at most exp(-phi), yielding a sharp leading coefficient. The all-mass formula applies solely to a nonnegative-witness restriction; it is not asserted for arbitrary signed or complex witnesses. Possible older equivalent quotient-gauge calculations remain a bibliographic risk.
title: Sharp indicator scale and positive-witness transition for the Kalton–Peck range gauge
